messages:
Alex Chen: Ok team — kicking off the BigBank pilot scoping thread. Need to align success criteria, SE/eng coverage, and timeline. Customer wants a 4-week working trial focused on secure invoice summarization + retrieval. Can each owner confirm availability and proposed deliverables?
Maria Gonzalez: I can take ownership of the security questionnaire / compliance asks. Quick Q: they require data-at-rest in us-east-1 and an audit log for model calls — is that supported in Private or Dedicated?
Samir Patel: For pricing — they’re sensitive to egress and peak concurrency. We should propose a reserved 2-week burst (Dedicated) + usage credits. Also need to confirm which models are allowed for PCI-like data.
Jessie Wu: For evals/prompts: propose 3 prompt families (extract key line items, classify risk flags, generate payment summaries). Suggested success metrics: 1) precision of extracted fields >= 95% 2) avg latency < 650ms p50 3) end-to-end accuracy on 100 sample invoices >= 92%. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Presales Bot: :bell: Reminder: POC template + SOW draft at https://redwood.internal/presales/poc-template. Use branch `bigbank-pilot` for configs.
Alex Chen: Thanks. Maria — Private supports us-east-1 and audit logs (we'll need KMS key + IAM roles). Dedicated could also work with VPC peering. Please confirm which they prefer.
Maria Gonzalez: Customer prefers Dedicated but needs vendor SOC2 section answered. I'll attach the SOC2 excerpt and the questionnaire answers by EOD tomorrow.
Samir Patel: For pricing, recommending: 2-week Dedicated reservation (8 GPUs equiv), then auto-fallback to Hosted with burst cap. Propose a credit of 10k tokens/day for pilot week 1. Also call out telemetry retention — they want 30d retention for traces.
Jessie Wu: Milestones I propose:
```
Week 0: Provision Dedicated pool + networking (+ IAM/KMS)
Week 1: Ingest dataset + baseline evals (100 invoices)
Week 2: Prompt tuning + rerank + acceptance tests
Week 3: Integration + latency/load tests
Week 4: Final report + handoff + runbook
```
Owners: Maria (sec/compliance), Samir (pricing/provision), Alex (integration + runbook), Jessie (evals/prompts).
Alex Chen: Perfect — can each owner add their concrete deadlines? I’ll draft the SOW after. Also need SE on-call hours during Week 2-3 (target 9am-6pm ET).
Maria Gonzalez: Deadlines — questionnaire answers by TOM EOD, SOC2 excerpt sent now, KMS request template by Day 2. SE on-call ok.
Samir Patel: I'll get the Dedicated cost estimate and reservation order by Day 1 morning. Confirming 8-GPU equiv, can scale to 12 transient if needed.
Jessie Wu: I'll drop the 100-sample prompt set and evaluation harness to the repo by Day 1 afternoon. Will include metric scripts (`evaluate_extraction.py`) and a small sample set.
Alex Chen: Great. Action items:
- Maria: security questionnaire + SOC2 answers (EOD tomorrow)
- Samir: Dedicated estimate + reservation (Day 1 AM)
- Jessie: eval harness + prompt families (Day 1 PM)
- Alex: SOW + runbook draft (Day 2)
I'll set up a 30-min alignment call tomorrow 10am ET — `@Maria Gonzalez @Samir Patel @Jessie Wu` please confirm. :calendar:
Maria Gonzalez: Confirmed 10am ET.
Samir Patel: Confirmed.
Jessie Wu: In.
Alex Chen: Thanks all — we'll use this thread for async updates. If anything blocks, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
